# Briain registry fixtures

Sanitized from read-only inspection on 2026-09-09 of the local briain data root:
`notes/projects/{astraweave,herdr-reviewr}.md`, retained linked worktrees, and their
matching `runs/<basename>/{status.json,job.yaml}`. Only relevant scalar shapes and
small unrelated fields needed to exercise the scanner are retained. Description
text includes synthetic colon/embedded-key edge cases; URLs are placeholders.

`@CHECKOUT@` is replaced with a temporary real repository path by
`tests/briain_registry.rs`. Linked-worktree `.git` files must be generated by Git
at test time: copying a live absolute gitdir pointer would depend on mutable data.
The test creates and invalidates those links in temporary directories only.

`opaque-run` deliberately does not identify its project in its basename. The
project comes from `job.yaml`; `state` and `phase` come from `status.json`.
Missing, malformed, duplicate, inactive, null, oversized and historical-only
records are instantiated alongside these fixtures inside temporary directories.
No test reads the operator's registry, checkouts, or run metadata.
